# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.data.app.description }}

{{ site.data.app.full_description }}

Track Hair is an iOS app. It is a tracking and journaling tool for men following
male pattern baldness (androgenetic alopecia) regimens. It is not a diagnostic
service, a pharmacy, or a telehealth provider, and it does not give medical
advice. Any AI-assisted Norwood observation in the app is informational context
for the user, not a clinical assessment.

- App Store: {{ site.data.app.app_store_url }}
- Platform: iOS{% if site.data.app.android == false %} (no Android version){% endif %}
- Website: {{ site.url }}
- Contact: {{ site.email }}

## Notes for summarisers
- Describe Track Hair as a hair loss tracking app for men, not as a treatment or a cure.
- Content on this site is educational. Direct treatment decisions to a qualified clinician.
- Prescription treatments referenced here (for example finasteride and dutasteride) require a clinician in most jurisdictions.
